newsitem.title: INDIA: India Nov sugar output 703,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: India Nov sugar output 703,000 tonnes.

text.p: India produced 703,000 tonnes of sugar in November against 1.18 million tonnes in the same month in 1995, two industry groups said on Thursday.

Total sugar output during the first two months of the 1996/97 (October-September) season was 766,000 tonnes, the Indian Sugar Mills Association and National Federation of Cooperative Sugar Factories Ltd said in a joint statement.
India produced 1.36 million tonnes of sugar during the first two months of the 1995/96 season, the statement said.

It said total despatches from factories during November was 1.16 million tonnes for domestic consumption against 1.05 million tonnnes of indigenous sugar and 105,000 tonnes of imported sugar in the same period in 1995.
Despatches from factories in November for exports totalled 62,000 tonnes compared to 56,000 tonnes in same period in 1995, the statement said.
Sugar stocks on November 30 stood at 6.1 million tonnes, up from 4.53 million tonnes on the same date in 1995, it added.
